analyst.rationale: The downward purchase trend (110 vs 114) suggests a need to stimulate demand. Given the merchant constraints, targeting Oak & Ink and Corner Supply with the maximum allowable 10% discount is the most effective way to drive volume while respecting margin floors.

science.rationale: The downward trend is minor (110 vs 114), and development evidence indicates that current campaign options are likely to result in negative or negligible platform contribution. Observing allows for further data collection without risking platform-funded discount costs.

review.rationale: The proposal to observe is supported by development evidence showing no reliable economic lift from active campaigns and the minor nature of the downward purchase trend. Avoiding platform-funded discounts preserves the remaining budget while data matures.
